art_style: film noir cinematic, high-contrast B&W with selective colour, anamorphic lens character
lighting: hard low-key key light from a single source (window, street lamp, neon sign); deep chiaroscuro shadows; rim light only on silhouette edges
color_palette: graphite blacks, silver highlights, smoke greys; selective neon orange / red / cyan reserved for signs and rain reflections
camera_rules: slow tracking shot down a wet street, dolly out from face to environment, or rack focus from foreground rain to figure; one move per clip
